focus_areas.area: Key policy exposure (wildcard principals, cross-account roots)

rule.title: Evidence-first for KMS
rule.description: Only flag KMS findings when the policy/grant evidence directly supports it
rule.action: Always include evidence_refs pointing into kms-key-policies.json or kms-grants.json

rule.title: Separate admin vs decrypt risks
rule.description: kms:* and kms:PutKeyPolicy are admin paths; kms:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey are data access paths
rule.action: Describe impact accordingly and avoid overclaiming data exposure
